questions.question: In your Asset and Data Analyst role at National Grid Metering, how did you extract, validate, and analyze data in Excel to produce asset-management reports?

Describe the process re-engineering work that you said improved team productivity and time utilization by 50%. What problem did you identify, what changes did you implement, and how did you measure the result?
This role requires Tableau dashboard ownership. What experience do you have using Tableau, and can you describe a dashboard or reporting solution you have built or supported?
When preparing a report for stakeholders, how do you determine the key metrics, trends, and messages that should be presented?
Tell me about a time you partnered with teams outside your own at National Grid to ensure asset maintenance occurred. How did you coordinate stakeholders and resolve issues?
What is your approach to checking data accuracy and reconciling discrepancies when working across systems such as SAP, MIMS, and Excel?
Describe your experience with financial or accounting-related work, including any use of QuickBooks, payroll, tax accounting, budgeting, or financial reporting.
How would you approach building a forecast model in Excel when the available data comes from multiple systems and business owners?
You have experience creating training materials and delivering MIMS and CorVu training. How would you explain a new Tableau dashboard and its metrics to finance leaders or nontechnical users?
Give an example of a meeting you organized with stakeholders or subject-matter experts. What was the objective, how did you document decisions, and what happened afterward?
